summary: Golden Minerals Co. filed Form 8-K disclosing a private placement of 3,740,000 common shares at $0.2290/share to Streamline Metals Capital Ltd., raising ~$856,463. Concurrently, Golden and its subsidiaries entered into a Share Purchase Agreement to sell all issued shares of certain subsidiaries to Streamline and Horizon Silver Resources Ltd. (Sale Transaction). The private placement is expected to close May 20, 2026, subject to regulatory approvals including the Toronto Stock Exchange. This dual transaction involves both equity issuance and asset divestiture, but is categorized as 'Other' as it does not fit a single special-situation category cleanly.
